name: design
description: Standalone design stage. Checks out an existing pipeline branch, runs an interactive phased implementation-design brainstorm over the approved spec (with the optional idea doc as implementation-shape context), verifies the run-dated design docs on disk, aligns them to the spec unattended, then pushes and records design_paths[] in the pipeline manifest.
author: arbitron

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Existing remote branch to check out and commit the designs on.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.description: Feature slug. Kept as given; the design stage never re-slugs.

inputs.name: base_branch
inputs.description: Recorded as the manifest's top-level base_branch when this stage's finish creates the manifest. Empty leaves it unset.

inputs.name: teams_webhook_url
inputs.description: Teams webhook URL, accepted for parity with the other stages. Leave empty in the committed sample.

inputs.name: spec_path
inputs.description: Path of the approved spec on the branch. Falls back to the pipeline manifest's spec entry when empty.

inputs.name: idea_path
inputs.description: Optional path of an idea doc on the branch; supplies implementation shape as extra design context.

nodes.label: Init workspace
nodes.description: Clone repo_url and add a worktree at ./work on the existing remote branch.

nodes.label: Promote vars
nodes.description: Lift work_dir and run_date to top-level vars and compute the run-dated design glob from the given slug.

nodes.label: Resolve inputs
nodes.description: Explicit spec_path/idea_path win; otherwise spec_path comes from the manifest's spec entry (required) and idea_path defaults to empty.

nodes.label: Clear this run's earlier designs
nodes.description: Reconciles this stage's owned file set before generating: removes today's design_glob matches (git rm + commit; history keeps them) so a same-day rerun with fewer phases cannot leave the first run's extra designs for finalize-docs to commit and the manifest to publish. Refuses any pattern that is not a design output.

nodes.label: Brainstorm: design
nodes.description: Interactive phased design brainstorm over the spec (plus optional idea doc). Writes ./work/docs/designs/<date>-<slug>-design-phase-N.md and commits locally. Not on a cycle; never pushes.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: push session
nodes.description: Pushes the approved design session before finalize-designs, so even a misnamed design file survives a later failure: an unpushed design lives only in a workspace that is deleted when the run ends.

nodes.label: Finalize designs
nodes.description: Verify the run-dated design files exist on disk and are non-empty; commit them if still uncommitted. Emits paths[].

nodes.label: Checkpoint: push designs
nodes.description: Pushes the finalized designs before align-designs, so an align agent that exhausts its retries cannot strand the approved designs.

nodes.label: Align designs
nodes.description: Unattended: read spec + designs, fix alignment and data-provenance gaps in place, commit locally.

nodes.label: Finalize aligned
nodes.description: Re-verify the design files on disk after alignment and commit any leftover edits. Emits the final paths[].

nodes.label: Record stage
nodes.description: Push the branch, then commit and push the design entry to .arbitron/pipeline/<slug>.json. design_paths stays a typed array. Its outputs are the stage contract.
